Here is my educational background.
My research interests include Machine Learning and Data Mining, especially:

The Learnware Paradigm provides a framework for turning well-trained models into reusable and composable units. Each learnware pairs a model with a specification that characterizes, organizes, and identifies its capabilities for reuse and collaboration on new tasks. As more learnwares join and interact within the system, their capabilities can be continually composed and evolved, enabling the system to solve problems that no single model could handle alone.

variants.text: Model Capability Mining studies how to discover, understand, characterize, and represent the abstract, latent, and high-dimensional functional capabilities manifested by trained models through their behavior across different data and tasks, revealing what each model can do, where it may be useful, and how its capabilities relate to those of other models. The resulting capability representations can serve as specifications in the Learnware Paradigm, enabling models to be organized, identified, reused, and composed for new tasks.
